pages.text: Forged from iron bars, iron blocks, obsidian and a $(item)Murmol Soul$(0).$(br2)When powered by redstone, any player or mob stepping on top is shrunk and imprisoned inside, unable to move or use items.$(br2)The trapped one can only break the cage barehanded (or with a pickaxe) to escape — it is as hard as obsidian. Cutting the redstone signal or breaking the cage releases the prisoner. Each cage holds a single entity.
